$comment: Who may do what, where. Validated against @custodes/schema Policy at startup. Every change is a reviewed PR. Signing keys are generated by the broker's Keyring; the only per-agent secret is the PAT.

pr-gate.$comment: ADR 0011: closes community PRs that break CONTRIBUTING.md, with a signed comment. hotl; the agent also caps itself at 10 closes per UTC day.

cheatsheet-review.$comment: ADR 0017: multi-model review of a pull request when the operator adds the trigger label; posts one review with inline suggestions (never APPROVE) and removes the label. hotl because every run is started by the operator (the agent re-checks who added the label in the timeline); sandbox only until its evals pass.
cheatsheet-review.$comment_requiresApprovalOn: ADR 0017 amendment: on OWASP a review is posted only after the operator approves it through the e-mailed link. The sandbox is listed too until the approval flow has passed its e2e there; the PR that adds OWASP to repos removes the sandbox entry.
